battle.name: 伊拉克戰爭
battle.theater: 伊拉克南部至中部戰線
battle.brief: 二〇〇三年三月十九日聯軍發動空襲，三月二十日地面部隊自科威特越境西進，二十六天內推進約五百公里至巴格達。M1艾布拉姆斯是第三步兵師、第一百零一空降師與第一海軍陸戰旅突擊縱隊的主戰坦克，以一二〇公厘滑膛炮與複合裝甲執行正面破壞、快速攻堅與營區支援任務。

kit.name: M1艾布拉姆斯
kit.history: 作為美國陸軍的主戰坦克，M1自1980年起服役，具備先進的複合裝甲與120公厘滑膛炮，為師級單位的突擊與防禦主力。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方分成聯軍與伊拉克兩大集團。聯軍以美國為核心，中央司令部司令湯米·弗蘭克斯中將統一指揮海、陸、空與情報作戰，聯軍地面部隊指揮部由約翰·阿比賽德中將負責整體陸上戰役計畫。陸上兵力劃成三個方向：西部戰線由第二軍軍長大衛·麥基爾南中將統籌，轄第三步兵師、第八十二空降師與第四步兵師；中部縱隊由第一百零一空降師推進，其師長起初是彼得·舒馬克少將，進攻巴格達期間由戴維·彼得雷烏斯少將接掌；南部巴士拉方向由詹姆斯·康韋少將率領的第一海軍陸戰師與第一海軍陸戰旅負責推進。除美軍外，英國在科威特設立東部戰區司令部，荷蘭、丹麥、波蘭、西班牙與義大利等國派出地面分隊或提供後勤與空中支援。伊拉克一方由薩達姆·侯賽因領導的阿拉伯復興黨執政當局指揮，伊拉克共和國軍保有完整的總參謀部與數個機械化師，共和國衛軍轄第一、第四與第五十一裝甲及機械化師等精銳部隊，並徵召費達因·薩達姆民兵與北部庫德族、什葉派武裝一同作戰；伊拉克空軍仍保有米格-25、米格-29、蘇-22與蘇-25機隊，防空則以地對地飛彈與高射炮構成骨架。
countriesEn: The opposing sides in this war fall into two camps. The coalition was built around the United States: Lieutenant General Tommy Franks commanded Central Command and unified the air, land, maritime and intelligence components, while Lieutenant General John Abizaid headed the Coalition Land Component Command, which drew up the overall land campaign plan. On the ground the coalition was split into three axes. The western axis was under Lieutenant General David McKiernan, commander of II Corps, with the 3rd Infantry Division, the 82nd Airborne Division and the 4th Infantry Division. The central column was the 101st Airborne Division, commanded at first by Major General Peter Schoomaker and taken over during the drive on Baghdad by Major General David Petraeus. The southern approach through Basra was handled by Major General James Conway with the 1st Marine Division and the 1st Marine Expeditionary Brigade. Alongside the Americans, Britain stood up an eastern theatre command in Kuwait, while the Netherlands, Denmark, Poland, Spain and Italy contributed ground detachments, or logistical and air support. On the Iraqi side, command lay with the ruling Arab Ba'ath Party government under Saddam Hussein. The Iraqi Republican Army retained an intact General Staff and several mechanised divisions, the Republican Guard fielded elite armoured and mechanised formations including the 1st, 4th and 51st, and the Fedayeen Saddam militia was mobilised alongside Kurdish and Shia armed groups in the north. The Iraqi air force still had MiG-25, MiG-29, Su-22 and Su-25 aircraft, and air defence rested on surface-to-surface missiles and antiaircraft guns.
people: 美軍方面的關鍵人物集中在少數幾個指揮位置。湯米·弗蘭克斯中將以中央司令部司令身份決定戰爭的政治與戰略框架；第二軍軍長大衛·麥基爾南中將選定沿科威特至巴格達的伊布拉斯高速公路作為主攻軸線，這個決定讓聯軍避開了北部山區的天然障礙。第一百零一空降師師長戴維·彼得雷烏斯少將帶領該師第187步兵團與第502步兵團從北面插向巴格達，其部隊參與了三月三十一日的搜索接管行動，把三個方向的縱隊在首都西北郊會合。第一海軍陸戰旅指揮官詹姆斯·康韋少將負責巴士拉方向的登陸與攻堅；第三營第69裝甲團在納西里亞附近的夜戰則由該營營長率領。伊拉克方面，所有戰略決策集中在薩達姆·侯賽因一身，他把共和國衛軍的裝甲師集中在巴格達以北與中部，意圖以首都抵抗拖慢聯軍推進；但指揮鏈條在連續空襲與地面打擊下迅速斷裂，第五十一機械化師與第一機械化師的指揮官在交戰中陣亡或失去聯絡，部隊被分割成各自求生的散兵。基層的關鍵人物包括在巴士拉附近夜戰中陣亡的少尉排長，以及四月初在巴格達上空誤擊兩架義大利 C-130 運輸機的阿帕契飛行小組。
peopleEn: On the American side the decisive figures occupied only a handful of command positions. Lieutenant General Tommy Franks, commanding Central Command, set the political and strategic frame of the war. Lieutenant General David McKiernan, commander of II Corps, chose the Euphrates Expressway from Kuwait to Baghdad as the main axis of advance, and that choice kept the coalition away from the natural barriers of the northern mountains. Major General David Petraeus, commanding the 101st Airborne Division, led the 187th and 502nd Infantry Regiments in from the north toward Baghdad; his formations took part in the Search and Take operation on 31 March, which joined the three columns of attack in the north-western approaches to the capital. Major General James Conway, commanding the 1st Marine Expeditionary Brigade, was responsible for the landing and the assault through Basra, while the 3rd Battalion, 69th Armour Regiment was led on the ground by its own commander during the night action near Nasiriyah. On the Iraqi side every strategic decision rested with Saddam Hussein. He concentrated the armoured divisions of the Republican Guard north of and inside Baghdad, hoping that resistance in the capital would slow the coalition advance, but the chain of command broke quickly under repeated air strikes and ground attacks: the commanders of the 51st Mechanised Division and the 1st Mechanised Division were killed or cut off during contact, and their formations were broken up into disconnected fragments. At the lower level the notable figures include the second lieutenant platoon leader killed in the night action near Basra, and the Apache flight crew that mistakenly hit two Italian C-130 transport aircraft over Baghdad in early April.
kits: 卡面這件 M1 艾布拉姆斯是聯軍裝備體系的核心，整個戰區部署約兩千輛，其中以配備 120 公厘滑膛炮的 M1A1 為主，另有部分 M1A2。該車重約 51 噸，採用複合裝甲與自動裝填機，乘員只有炮手與車長兩人，尾艙彈架可攜帶 26 發 120 公厘炮彈，炮塔內另備 5 發，主要彈種為穿甲燃燒曳光彈、破甲彈與高爆榴彈，發射後拋殼自動拋出。公路速度約每小時 67 公里，越野可維持每小時 40 公里，滿載行程約 480 公里，但戰術行軍時每小時耗油可達 190 公升上下，戰線上因此配置大量 M978 重型加油車、M1070 平板拖車與前線供油點。與坦克協同的是布萊德利戰鬥車，以二五公厘鏈式砲與陶式反裝甲飛彈配合步兵，坦克負責消滅敵方裝甲目標，步兵戰車則提供側射火力與反步兵支援。空中部分包括 AH-64 阿帕契直昇機、UH-60 黑鷹、CH-47 支奴干，固定翼有 A-10、F-15E、F/A-18 及 B-52 與 B-1 轟炸機，並使用戰斧巡航飛彈與 MQ-1 偵察無人機。伊拉克方面的裝備以 T-55、T-62 與 T-72 主力坦克、裝甲運兵車、四管高射炮、RPG-7 與 AK 系列步槍為主，並改裝滑翔炸藥攻擊聯軍直升機。工程與運輸方面投入裝甲架橋車、浮橋與挖掘機，部落民兵則以馬匹和駱駝作短程輸送。
kitsEn: The M1 Abrams on the card is the core of the coalition equipment system. About two thousand were deployed across the theatre, mostly M1A1s fitted with the 120 mm smoothbore gun, together with a number of M1A2s. The vehicle weighs about 51 tonnes, uses composite armour and a bustle autoloader, and carries only two crew, the commander and the gunner. The bustle rack holds 26 rounds of 120 mm ammunition with five more in the turret, the main types being APFSDS, HEAT and high-explosive rounds, and the empty case is ejected automatically. Road speed is around 67 km/h, cross-country it can keep up roughly 40 km/h, and full-range endurance is about 480 km, but in tactical movement the tank burns up to some 190 litres an hour, so the line of advance was supported by large numbers of M978 heavy fuel trucks, M1070 tank transporters and forward refuelling points. Working with the tanks were Bradley fighting vehicles, carrying the 25 mm chain gun and TOW anti-tank missiles, the tanks hunting enemy armour while the Bradleys provided flank fire and support against infantry. On the air side the inventory included AH-64 Apaches, UH-60 Black Hawks and CH-47 Chinooks, with A-10, F-15E, F/A-18 and B-52 and B-1 bombers on the fixed-wing side, plus Tomahawk cruise missiles and MQ-1 reconnaissance drones. Iraqi equipment consisted mainly of T-55, T-62 and T-72 tanks, armoured personnel carriers, quadruple antiaircraft guns, RPG-7 launchers and AK-series rifles, with converted glide bombs used against coalition helicopters. Engineering and transport units fielded armoured bridge carriers, pontoon bridges and excavators, while tribal militia moved supplies short distances on horses and camels.
tactics: 戰役分空襲與地面兩階段。空襲階段自三月十九日展開，聯軍以精確導引炸藥打擊共和國衛軍指揮所、空軍基地、飛彈陣地與裝甲集結地，頭二十四小時出動約一千架次、投擲逾兩千枚炸彈，並以戰斧巡航飛彈攻擊固定目標。地面階段由三路縱隊平行推進：第三步兵師沿伊布拉斯高速公路向西北直取巴格達，途經納西里亞時與第五十一機械化師正面交鋒；第一海軍陸戰師在南部海灣登陸後掃平巴士拉；第一百零一空降師則從北部插向首都西側。裝甲部隊的戰法以分散、分散射擊與側翼射擊為主，利用 M1 的射程與火控優勢在兩千公尺外以穿甲彈打擊 T-62 與 T-72，再以步兵戰車封住殘存缺口；三月三十一日的搜索接管行動讓三路縱隊在巴格達北郊會師，切斷市區退路。進入城區後，攻擊改為逐棟清剿，直昇機提供近距支援，裝甲車在狹窄街道上受限，步兵大量改為徒步作戰。渡河與補給是另一考驗，底格里斯河與幼發拉底河上的公路橋多被破壞，聯軍靠裝甲架橋車與浮橋在數日內搭出通路。戰役末段，費達因民兵與什葉派武裝在巴格達及中部城鎮發動抵抗，聯軍轉入清剿作戰。
tacticsEn: The campaign ran in an air phase and a ground phase. The air phase opened on 19 March, with the coalition using precision-guided bombs against Republican Guard command posts, air bases, missile sites and armoured assembly areas; in the first twenty-four hours it flew about one thousand strike sorties, dropped more than two thousand bombs, and used Tomahawk cruise missiles against fixed targets. In the ground phase three columns advanced in parallel. The 3rd Infantry Division drove north-west along the Euphrates Expressway straight for Baghdad, meeting the 51st Mechanised Division in the open at Nasiriyah. The 1st Marine Division landed on the southern coast and cleared Basra. The 101st Airborne Division came in from the north toward the western side of the capital. Armoured units fought dispersed, using flanking and oblique fire, exploiting the range and fire-control advantage of the M1 to engage T-62s and T-72s with APFSDS rounds at two thousand metres before the Bradley infantry fighting vehicles closed the remaining gaps. On 31 March the Search and Take operation joined the three columns in the northern approaches to Baghdad and cut the escape routes out of the city. Once inside the built-up area the assault turned into clearance block by block, with helicopters providing close support. Armour was badly restricted in narrow streets and the infantry fought largely on foot. River crossings and logistics were the other test: most of the road bridges over the Tigris and Euphrates had been blown, and the coalition threw armoured bridge carriers and pontoon bridges across in a matter of days. In the closing phase the Fedayeen militia and Shia armed groups resisted in Baghdad and in the towns of the middle region, and the coalition shifted to clearance operations.
data: 可核對的數字集中在兵力與損失兩個方向。聯軍最高地面兵力約 16 至 17 萬人，其中美軍約 13 萬人，英軍約 4 萬 5 千人，其餘盟國分隊合計 1 萬 5 千至 2 萬人左右；美軍在戰區配備約 2,000 輛 M1 系列坦克與約 2,000 輛步兵戰車。伊拉克軍常被估算為 38 萬 5 千至 40 萬人，共和國衛軍另有 8 萬至 11 萬人。首日空襲出動約一千架次並投擲逾兩千枚精確導引炸彈，開戰首週發射數百枚戰斧巡航飛彈。時間線方面，三月十九日空襲開始，三月二十日地面進攻，四月一日聯軍進入巴格達市中心，四月九日宣布控制全城，五月初主要戰鬥告一段落，十二月十三日薩達姆被捕，2006 年 12 月 28 日被處決。科威特至巴格達的公路距離約 500 公里。損失方面，美軍自開戰至 2011 年撤軍為止陣亡逾 4,600 人，英軍自 2003 年至 2014 年陣亡 179 人，伊拉克軍陣亡人數的官方統計在數千人量級，具體數字因戰後清點方式不同而分歧明顯；裝甲方面，伊拉克軍約 2,000 至 3,000 輛裝甲車輛被摧毀或擄獲，M1 系列損失數十輛，其中相當一部分是履帶、動力與傳動系統的機械故障，而不是被敵方火力直接擊毀。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around strength and losses. Coalition ground forces peaked at roughly 160,000 to 170,000 men, of whom about 130,000 were American, roughly 45,000 British, and some 15,000 to 20,000 from the other coalition partners. The Americans deployed about 2,000 M1 series tanks and about 2,000 infantry fighting vehicles in the theatre. The Iraqi army is usually put at 385,000 to 400,000 men, with a further 80,000 to 110,000 in the Republican Guard. The first day's air strikes involved around one thousand sorties and more than two thousand precision-guided bombs, and several hundred Tomahawk cruise missiles were fired in the opening week. On the timeline: the air campaign began on 19 March, the ground invasion on 20 March, coalition troops entered central Baghdad on 1 April, control of the city was declared on 9 April, the main fighting ended in early May, Saddam Hussein was captured on 13 December and executed on 28 December 2006. The road distance from Kuwait to Baghdad is about 500 kilometres. On losses, American military deaths from the start of the war to the 2011 withdrawal exceeded 4,600, British military deaths from 2003 to 2014 came to 179, and official Iraqi military death figures sit in the low thousands, with the exact figure varying widely according to how the count was made after the war. On armour, some 2,000 to 3,000 Iraqi armoured vehicles were destroyed or captured, and the M1 series lost only a few dozen vehicles, a large share of them to failures of the track, powerpack and transmission rather than to enemy fire.
cause: 開戰的直接背景是聯合國核查的失敗。1991 年海灣戰爭結束後，安理會先後通過第 678 與第 687 號決議要求伊拉克廢除大規模殺傷性武器，核查單位在伊拉克境內發現過大規模的化學與生物武器計畫，但 2002 年聯合國的報告認定薩達姆政府仍保有未申報的武器生產能力，並且拒絕接受第 1441 號決議所要求的補充核查。美國政府把這些發現視為規避處置的證據，在九一一事件之後把反恐框架延伸至伊拉克。2002 年 8 月 26 日，布希總統在國會演說中指稱伊拉克持有大規模殺傷性武器並支援恐怖主義；同年 10 月，國會通過決議，授權總統在聯合國核查再次失敗時可單方面動用武力；2003 年 1 月底，英國首相布萊爾提出八點計畫並發出最後通牒，安理會表決時只有三票反對。三月十七日美英再向伊拉克提出四十八小時最後通牒，安理會第1441號決議未能阻止戰爭，聯軍在三月十九日展開空襲，三月二十日地面部隊越境進攻。
causeEn: The immediate background to the war was the failure of United Nations inspection. After the 1991 Gulf War the Security Council adopted Resolution 678 and then Resolution 687, requiring Iraq to destroy its weapons of mass destruction. Inspectors on Iraqi soil found extensive chemical and biological weapons programmes, but in 2002 the United Nations reported that Saddam Hussein's government still possessed undisclosed production capability and refused the supplementary inspections demanded by Resolution 1441. The United States government read those findings as proof of evasion, and after the attacks of 11 September 2001 extended the counter-terrorism framework to Iraq. On 26 August 2002 President Bush told Congress that Iraq held weapons of mass destruction and supported terrorism. In October of the same year Congress passed a resolution authorising the president to use force unilaterally if inspections failed again. In late January 2003 the British prime minister Tony Blair set out an eight-point plan and issued an ultimatum, and the Security Council vote drew only three opposing votes. On 17 March the United States and Britain gave Iraq a final forty-eight hour ultimatum; Resolution 1441 did not stop the war, the coalition opened its air campaign on 19 March, and ground forces crossed the border on 20 March.
impact: 戰爭的後果延伸到二十年後仍未結束。政權層面，薩達姆政府垮台，伊拉克共和國軍與共和國衛軍被解散，數十萬武裝人員被解除武裝或轉入地下，伊拉克先後經歷臨時政府與過渡政府、聯邦時期的多次改組，直到 2010 年才選出第一屆民選議會。軍事層面，2003 年 5 月之後聯軍面對的主要是游擊與反叛作戰，2004 年起武裝衝突從費達伊亞擴散到全國，伊斯蘭主義組織在此建立分支並在後來演變為蓋爾組織。經濟與民生層面，國家動員能力崩解，電力與水務長期不足，石油設施與重建工程屢受破壞，聯軍的重建開支與伊拉克的財政崩潰互相放大，2011 年美軍最終撤離。2014 年之後的蓋爾行動、2020 年擊斃蘇萊曼尼的行動與 2023 年美軍同伊拉克民兵的直接衝突，都是這場戰爭的延伸產物。從軍事學角度，這一役也提供兩項教材：現代主戰坦克在沙漠戰中最大的耗損來自機械故障而不是敵方火力，而勝利方對佔領區的治理能力，往往比攻城本身更能決定戰爭的成敗。
impactEn: The consequences of the war were still unfolding twenty years later. At the level of government, the Saddam regime collapsed, the Iraqi Republican Army and the Republican Guard were dissolved, hundreds of thousands of armed men were either disarmed or driven underground, and Iraq went through the interim government, the transitional administration and repeated reorganisations of the federal period, only electing its first parliament in 2010. At the military level, what the coalition faced after May 2003 was chiefly guerrilla and insurgent warfare: from 2004 the armed conflict spread from Firdos across the whole country, and Islamist groups built a branch there that later evolved into the Islamic State. On the economic and civilian side, the state's ability to mobilise collapsed, electricity and water services stayed short, oil facilities and reconstruction projects were repeatedly damaged, the coalition's reconstruction spending and Iraq's fiscal collapse reinforced each other, and American troops finally withdrew in 2011. The campaign against Islamic State from 2014, the killing of General Soleimani in 2020 and the direct clashes between American forces and Iraqi militias in 2023 are all extensions of this war. For military study the campaign also yielded two lessons: in desert warfare the largest losses of a modern main battle tank come from mechanical failure rather than enemy fire, and the winner's ability to govern the occupied territory usually matters more to the outcome of a war than the assault on the city itself.
result: 結果方面，聯軍以二十六天的地面進攻瓦解了伊拉克的抵抗體系。第四步兵師的先頭部隊在 3 月 25 日進入巴格達南郊，第三步兵師的裝甲縱隊同日在巴格達以南擊潰共和國衛軍第一機械化師，第五十一機械化師則在納西里亞被分割；4 月 1 日聯軍部隊進入巴格達市中心，4 月 9 日宣布控制全城，伊拉克軍的有組織抵抗隨之瓦解，共和國衛軍的裝甲師全數失去戰鬥能力。費達因·薩達姆民兵在南部城鎮的抵抗被逐步解除，武裝人員轉入游擊形式，聯軍隨即把主要兵力轉向維持佔領與追捕高層。薩達姆於 12 月 13 日在提克里特附近被捕，2006 年 12 月 28 日被處決。戰役在 2003 年 5 月 1 日科威特的勝利儀式後正式告一段落，但戰爭本身並未因此結束，而是以漫長的佔領戰與反叛戰形式延續到 2011 年美軍最後撤離。聯軍的代價同樣具體：美軍在整場戰爭中陣亡逾 4,600 人，M1 艾布拉姆斯損失數十輛，多數因機械故障與戰術消耗，而不是被伊拉克軍擊毀。
resultEn: In result, twenty-six days of ground advance broke the Iraqi system of resistance. The leading troops of the 4th Infantry Division reached the southern outskirts of Baghdad on 25 March, the armoured column of the 3rd Infantry Division destroyed the Republican Guard 1st Mechanised Division south of the city on the same day, and the 51st Mechanised Division was cut up at Nasiriyah. Coalition troops entered central Baghdad on 1 April, control of the whole city was declared on 9 April, and organised Iraqi resistance collapsed, taking the combat power of the Republican Guard armoured divisions with it. The resistance of the Fedayeen Saddam militia in the southern towns was gradually broken and its men turned to guerrilla tactics, and the coalition shifted its main effort to holding the country and hunting the leadership. Saddam Hussein was captured near Tikrit on 13 December and executed on 28 December 2006. The campaign formally ended with the victory ceremony in Kuwait on 1 May 2003, but the war itself did not end there: it continued as a long occupation and insurgency until the last American troops left in 2011. The coalition's costs were equally concrete: more than 4,600 American military deaths over the whole war, and a loss of a few dozen M1 Abrams, most of them to mechanical failure and tactical wear rather than to Iraqi fire.
